changes.summary: Bound this recipe to the evidence-backed model capability authority without changing runtime behavior.

changes.details: The recipe now carries every author-selectable Podman build input through the signed Controller-to-agent request, including a bounded capability list that defaults to empty. The agent drops all capabilities before adding only declared allowlisted entries inside Podman's rootless user namespace; host privilege, devices, mounts, sockets, security options, storage, cgroups, and generated image identity remain fixed platform policy.
changes.summary: Declared explicit resource limits and rootless capabilities in the portable recipe build contract.
Declared explicit recipe alignment metadata; no runtime behavior changed.

changes.details: Keeps the complete 262144-token context while raising mem-fraction-static from 0.75 to 0.80. MiaAI-Lab's pinned DGX Spark table measures that profile with a 328898-token KV pool, about 12.5 GB of KV memory, 22.0 GB free GPU-side memory after graphs, and about 20 GB host MemAvailable. Vonk separately applies a conservative 119 GB startup, 114 GB steady-state, 5 GB growth, and 7 GB reserve contract, yielding an exact 126 GB admission envelope; physical Vonk acceptance remains pending.
changes.summary: Aligned the full-context Ling launch and Controller admission envelope with the pinned DGX Spark evidence.

changes.details: The draft artifact was already hydrated and mounted at its immutable revision; this release makes the corresponding model-version dependency explicit without changing the installed runtime.
changes.summary: Declared the exact external Ling DSpark checkpoint in the recipe dependency closure.

changes.details: Pins the public INT4 target, external DSpark draft, CUDA 13 ARM64 image, 262K context, bounded concurrency, ReplaySSM cache, Ling parsers, and an offline OpenAI-compatible launch.
